title: Minimise the Busiest Worker
body: Assign each of n jobs to one of k workers. A worker's load is the sum of their jobs' times. Jobs need not be contiguous. Print the smallest possible load of the busiest worker.
inp: Line 1: n k. Line 2: the n job times.

samples.ex: {4, 4, 4} and {5, 5}. A greedy "give it to the least loaded worker" gives 13.

lc: 1723 Find Minimum Time to Finish All Jobs
ref:
import sys, heapq
from collections import defaultdict, deque
sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 20)

def workers(s):
    t = list(map(int, s.split())); n, k = t[0], t[1]; jobs = sorted(t[2:2+n], reverse=True)
    best = [sum(jobs)]; load = [0]*k
    def go(i, cur):
        if cur >= best[0]: return
        if i == n: best[0] = cur; return
        seen = set()
        for w in range(k):
            if load[w] in seen: continue
            seen.add(load[w]); load[w] += jobs[i]
            go(i + 1, max(cur, load[w])); load[w] -= jobs[i]
    go(0, 0)
    return str(best[0])

print(workers(sys.stdin.read()))
